notes.title: Get your own Klonoa Costume Set!
notes.content:
[h3]We are pleased to announce that the Klonoa Costume Set has been released freely for all users. Players will be able to change into outfits featured in the original games: "Klonoa: Door to Phantomile" and "Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42476337/2b5dcfe9c937c0af7bf4dc0e84182f2cd93c82c0.png[/img]
*Players can change outfits in the Costume section in the Options menu.
In order to use this content, please update the game to the newest version.

Thank you for your continuous support to KLONOA Phantasy Reverie Series.
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730680/Klonoa_Phantasy_Reverie_Series/
